task_description: Build the expo-subscription-app reference starter (Task 4 from the spec): a fully standalone Expo React Native mobile app with Supabase Auth, RevenueCat digital purchases, Sentry error reporting, SQLite cache, SecureStore, bounded persistent queue, deep-link lifecycle, and comprehensive tests including Properties 9 and 10.

verification.summary: All 86 tests pass across 13 suites. tsc --noEmit clean. ESLint clean. expo export --platform android succeeds (1241 modules bundled). EAS config validates. Standalone copy at /projects/standalone-expo-test/ installs and passes all checks independently. Property tests use fast-check with 150 runs each, testing real domain logic (queue capacity/idempotency, monetization eligibility routing).
